utc_timestamps.scope: fields named utc or ending in _utc
utc_timestamps.fractional_seconds: preserve significant digits and remove only trailing zeroes

numbers.float_exponent: lowercase e, no plus sign, no leading exponent zeroes

precision.raw_provider_values: preserve the parsed finite value; never round or correct during canonical serialization
precision.derived_metric_values: serialize the computed value without additional canonicalization rounding
precision.display_values: rounding is permitted only in presentation-specific payloads and must not replace raw/provenance evidence

identity: SHA-256 over the canonical UTF-8 bytes including the final LF
integrations: readiness/evidence checksums that require deterministic identity
exclusions: no production corpus rehash or rewrite
